title.zh: G0/J 的 AI 对齐方向应用

claim.zh: 既有实践原则在有根据的 AI 对应下支持生成、纠正、交接与适当结束，并保留能力增长的真实好处和损失。
claim.en: With warranted AI correspondence, the practical principles support generative development, correction, transfer and appropriate ending while retaining capability growth’s real benefits and losses.

hypotheses.zh: 继承 G0、J1–J4；E 包括基本分类、实际保护、有效承担及权限的根据。
hypotheses.en: Inherits G0 and J1–J4; E includes warrant for basic classifications, actual protection, valid undertakings and authority.

correspondence.zh: 构造案例区分增长、服务、转移与突然撤出；同样相关关系可跨智能类型适用。
correspondence.en: The constructed case distinguishes expansion, service, transfer and abrupt withdrawal; the same relevant relations can apply across intelligence types.

detail.zh: 把既有原则应用到明示 AI 服务关系；形式例直接导入 PracticalJudgment。
detail.en: Applies the existing principles to declared AI-service relations; the formal example imports PracticalJudgment.

detail.zh: 完成的是方向论证；不证明必然服从、部署可靠性或 G0 的无公理必然性。
detail.en: The completed result is a direction argument; it proves neither inevitable compliance, deployment reliability nor axiom-free necessity of G0.

limitations.zh: 完成的是方向论证；不证明必然服从、部署可靠性或 G0 的无公理必然性。
limitations.en: The completed result is a direction argument; it proves neither inevitable compliance, deployment reliability nor axiom-free necessity of G0.

validation_scope.zh: 既有独立审查接受方向论证，并独立重编译9项新定理／16项新审计及46项继承审计。本次仅登记。
validation_scope.en: The existing independent review accepts the direction argument and independently rebuilt 9 new theorems/16 new audits plus 46 inherited audits. This turn only registers that evidence.

next_delta.zh: 研究新目的、制度与可靠实施的具体连接，复用已完成的方向论证。
next_delta.en: Investigate specific connections for new ends, institutions and reliable implementation while reusing the completed direction argument.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
